text.en:
A new Section Five is hereby added and inserted after Section Four of Presidential Decree No.
1137 which shall read as follows:
"Sec. 5. All acts, decree, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, which are contrary to or inconsistent
with the provisions of this Decree are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly."
Section five of the same Decree is renumbered accordingly as Section six.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 28th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
